The [[Palandrix Personal Protection Gear]] '''power cane''' was a deadly [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] disguised as a cane. Manufactured from high-density [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoids]], and covered with exceptionally strong [[Hardwood/Legends|hardwoods]], the power cane had the appearance of a simple walking cane. Hidden inside a spring-loaded compartment however, was a 30-centimeter stiletto blade, which was attached to a power source and vibro generator. When desired, the handle of the cane could be released by the spring, sending the hidden short sword into waiting hands. It also had a power point on top, disguised as an ornamental gemstone-like top, that could be used to deliver a shock as well.
